Use the full Muse Spark 1.3 token budget. Audit combined-slip and load-sensitivity behavior for the 2025 BMW M5. The user reports tires feel rock-hard and low-grip. Determine whether braking/throttle is consuming lateral capacity too aggressively, whether the superellipse/weighting functions are over-clipping force, or whether load sensitivity makes the heavy M5 lose too much mu on loaded outside tires. Do not mask sign or suspension defects with extra grip. Inspect TireModel.ts, WheelDynamics.ts, Vehicle.ts, m5G90.ts, validation skidpad/step-steer/braking tests, and tire tests. Propose changes only if supported, with deterministic trail-braking/power-on/load-transfer regressions and test:m5-validation:strict.
